source.title: Some open problems in ordinary differential equations and fixed points of (weakly inward) maps in Banach spaces

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/4073812 with trailing identifier 4073812. The zbMATH API returned resolver metadata for Zbl 0657.47052: Klaus Deimling, "Some open problems in ordinary differential equations and fixed points of (weakly inward) maps in Banach spaces", published in Nonlinear analysis and applications, Proc. 7th Int. Conf., Arlington/Tex. 1986, Lecture Notes in Pure and Applied Mathematics 109, pages 153-159 (1987). The API review text includes four problem statements, but resolver/API review text was treated only as metadata/discovery under the zbMATH source-family rules.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only. Direct shell fetch of the supplied zbMATH page returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge. The zbMATH API exposed bibliographic data and review text but no outgoing full-text links (links=[]), so it was not used as the primary extraction source.

failure_mode=paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only. Bounded exact-work recovery used the exact title, author, Zbl identifier, source title, Lecture Notes volume 109, page range 153-159, and ISBN 9780824778101. Search candidates included Perlego, Routledge/CRC, OverDrive, bookseller pages, and secondary citations; accessible pages exposed book metadata, tables of contents, subscription/read-now prompts, or references, not the readable chapter/article body with page-localized problem statements.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was recovered. The source adequacy gate forbids extracting open problems from zbMATH resolver/API review text, book tables of contents, citation metadata, search snippets, or secondary references.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim open-problem quotes with page numbers or stable locators from a readable primary source artifact.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-4073812.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
